// Leo Dusk: the Leo collection's look. Violet glass over a painted dusk, a mint, gold and rose
// terminal, and the same colors in every collection extension (they draw theme tokens: accent,
// success, warning, danger). Edit and save: the running app repaints at once.
{
  "name": "Leo Dusk",
  "description": "Violet glass over a painted dusk; mint, gold and rose tones.",

  // The terminal theme and its colors. ANSI 1, 2, 3 and 4 become the danger, success, warning and
  // highlight tones every extension draws with; colors.accent is the accent.
  "appearance.theme": "Rose Pine Moon",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#16121f",
    "foreground": "#e8e3f5",
    "cursor": "#f5c2e7",
    "selection": "#2f2750",
    "accent": "#a78bfa",
    "0": "#1f1a2e",
    "1": "#f2708a",
    "2": "#7ee0b5",
    "3": "#f6c177",
    "4": "#7aa2f7",
    "5": "#c49cff",
    "6": "#6fd3e8",
    "7": "#cfc8e6",
    "8": "#585075",
    "9": "#ff8fa6",
    "10": "#9cf0cb",
    "11": "#ffd89a",
    "12": "#9bbcff",
    "13": "#dcbcff",
    "14": "#94e6f5",
    "15": "#f7f4ff"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // A painted dusk behind tinted glass. Popovers keep their own see-through material.
  "appearance.background": "hesselbom-dusk",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.84,

  // The sidebar is its own deeper violet glass, its sections cards.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#110d1a",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.72,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "card",

  // Panes: terminals and chats a touch more solid than the New Tab page, where the clock sits.
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#16121f",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.86,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#16121f",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.88,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#16121f",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.66,

  // Work shows as a violet arc.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#a78bfa",

  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable"
}
